name: Holiday Inn & Suites Batangas Limapark
short_description: A 134-room upper-midscale hotel inside the Lima Technology Centre in Malvar, Batangas -- the first and only Holiday Inn in the province.
ai_summary: Holiday Inn & Suites Batangas Limapark by IHG sits inside the Lima Technology Centre business and industrial park in Malvar, Batangas, about a 1-minute drive from The Outlets at Lipa and roughly two hours south of Metro Manila. The 134-room property is the first and only Holiday Inn in Batangas province, built primarily for the industrial-park workforce and weekend staycation travelers. Guests consistently praise the Horizon outdoor pool, attentive and welcoming front-desk and F&B staff, and the weekend buffet at Plum Pan Asian Cuisine, while some reviews note the facilities are starting to show their age relative to newer competitors in the area.

pros: The first and only Holiday Inn hotel in Batangas province
Horizon outdoor pool with free cabanas and umbrellas draws consistent guest praise
134 air-conditioned rooms with amenities including safe boxes and flat-screen TVs
Two on-site restaurants, including Plum Pan Asian Cuisine's weekend buffet
Staff service and hospitality repeatedly singled out by guests as a highlight
cons: Some rooms and public areas are described as showing their age
Set inside an industrial/technology park rather than a leisure destination, so it suits staycations and business travel over sightseeing bases
research_highlights: Guest reviews consistently highlight the pool area and attentive front-desk and restaurant staff
The weekend buffet at Plum Pan Asian Cuisine is repeatedly called out as a standout
Positioned as a staycation base roughly two hours from Metro Manila, one minute from The Outlets at Lipa
research_watchouts: A subset of reviews note the property could use a refresh in places
Located inside the Lima Technology Centre industrial park rather than a beach or heritage-town setting

faqs.question: How many rooms does Holiday Inn & Suites Batangas Limapark have?
faqs.answer: The hotel has 134 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with amenities such as a flat-screen TV, safe box, electric tea pot, and free toiletries, with a selection of rooms also offering balconies or pool views for an additional staycation-style feel.

faqs.question: Where exactly is Holiday Inn & Suites Batangas Limapark located?
faqs.answer: It sits inside the Lima Technology Centre business park in Malvar, Batangas, about a one-minute drive from The Outlets at Lipa mall and roughly a two-hour drive south of Metro Manila, making it the first and only Holiday Inn property in Batangas province.
